"""A neutral host exposes scoped metadata without acquiring source or authority."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

import pytest

from devtools.agents.coding.models import CodingLimits, CodingProgress
from devtools.agents.coding.repository import (
    CodingObjective,
    EditLimits,
    RepositoryCodingHost,
)
from devtools.context import Repository, RepositoryResourceAddress
from devtools.context.repository.corpus import define_repository_text_corpus
from devtools.context.repository.discovery import discover_repository_resource_addresses
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Duration
from devtools.resources.commands import Command
from devtools.resources.filesystem import TextFile, write
from devtools.tools.checks import FixedCheck, FixedCheckPlan
from devtools.tools.errors import ToolInputError
from devtools.tools.source import SourceScope

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from pathlib import Path

    from devtools.models.interaction import ModelToolCall


def make_host(root: Path, *, prompt_bytes: int = 32768) -> RepositoryCodingHost:
    files = {
        "package/source.py": "# private-source-marker\nvalue = 'é'\n",
        "README.md": "read-only-secret\n",
    }
    for name, content in files.items():
        (root / name).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        write(TextFile(resolve_path(root / name), content))
    write(TextFile(resolve_path(root / "outside.py"), "outside-private-marker"))
    repo = Repository.new()
    addresses = tuple(RepositoryResourceAddress(n) for n in files)
    scope = SourceScope.observe(
        root=resolve_path(root),
        repository=repo,
        addresses=addresses,
    )
    corpus = define_repository_text_corpus(
        discovery=discover_repository_resource_addresses(
            repository=repo,
            root=scope.root,
            requested_addresses=addresses,
            maximum_resource_count=4,
            maximum_traversal_entry_count=32,
        ),
        selected_addresses=addresses,
    )
    objective = CodingObjective(
        "Inspect the authorized project before proposing work.",
        scope,
        addresses[:1],
        FixedCheckPlan(
            scope.root,
            (
                FixedCheck(
                    "never-entered",
                    Command(sys.executable)
                    .args("-I", "-c", "pass")
                    .cwd(scope.root)
                    .with_timeout(Duration.seconds(5)),
                ),
            ),
            scope,
        ),
        EditLimits(4096, 32768, 8192, 2),
        8192,
        prompt_bytes,
    )

    async def authorize(_call: ModelToolCall, _value: object) -> None:
        return

    async def effect(_changes: object) -> None:
        pytest.fail("Metadata preparation must not execute an edit")

    return RepositoryCodingHost(
        objective,
        corpus=corpus,
        authorize=authorize,
        apply_changes=effect,
        archive=lambda _: None,
        restore=lambda _path, _text: None,
    )


def progress() -> CodingProgress:
    return CodingProgress(
        CodingLimits(2, 1, 4, Duration.seconds(5), Duration.seconds(20)),
    )


def inventory(request: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:  # noqa: ANN401 -- inspect public wire values
    entries = []
    for message in request.prompt.messages:
        try:
            value = json.loads(message.content)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict) and "resources" in value:
            entries.append(value)
    assert len(entries) == 1, "Exactly one scoped metadata inventory is required"
    return entries[0]


def test_first_request_scoped_inventory(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    host = make_host(tmp_path)
    request = asyncio.run(host.prepare(progress()))
    data = inventory(request)
    assert_metadata(data, host)
    content = "\n".join(m.content for m in request.prompt.messages)
    assert host.objective.text in content
    assert not any(s in content for s in ("private-source-marker", "read-only-secret", "outside.py", "outside-private-marker", str(tmp_path)))
    assert not host.disclosures
    assert not host.custody.capture()[host.objective.editable[0]].startswith("changed")


def assert_metadata(data, host):
    assert data["repository_id"] == str(host.scope.snapshot.repository_id)
    assert data["snapshot_id"] == str(host.scope.snapshot.id)
    assert data["source_acquired"] is False
    rows = {row["address"]: row for row in data["resources"]}
    assert set(rows) == {"package/source.py", "README.md"}
    assert rows["package/source.py"]["editable"] is True
    assert rows["README.md"]["editable"] is False
    for resource in host.scope.snapshot.resources:
        row = rows[resource.address.value]
        assert row["content_identity"] == str(resource.content_identity)
        assert row["byte_size"] == len(resource.content.encode("utf-8"))


def test_inventory_not_duplicated_on_prepare(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    host = make_host(tmp_path)
    first = asyncio.run(host.prepare(progress()))
    second = asyncio.run(host.prepare(progress()))
    assert inventory(first) == inventory(second)
    assert [m.content for m in first.prompt.messages] == [
        m.content for m in second.prompt.messages
    ]
    assert not host.disclosures


def test_inventory_charged_to_prompt_budget(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    host = make_host(tmp_path)
    request = asyncio.run(host.prepare(progress()))
    # A bound that fits the old objective-only request must not silently omit metadata.
    from dataclasses import asdict  # noqa: PLC0415 -- literal byte boundary

    from devtools.models.interaction import Prompt  # noqa: PLC0415

    objective_only = replace(
        request,
        prompt=Prompt("", "messages", (request.prompt.messages[0],)),
    )
    maximum = len(json.dumps(asdict(objective_only), ensure_ascii=False).encode()) + 1
    bounded = make_host(tmp_path / "bounded", prompt_bytes=maximum)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="budget"):
        asyncio.run(bounded.prepare(progress()))
    assert not bounded.requests
    assert not bounded.disclosures


def test_inventory_does_not_bypass_currentness(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    host = make_host(tmp_path)
    write(
        TextFile(resolve_path(tmp_path / "package/source.py"), "changed externally\n"),
    )
    with pytest.raises(ToolInputError, match="no longer current"):
        asyncio.run(host.prepare(progress()))
    assert not host.requests

from .models import CodingCompletion, CodingLimits, CodingProgress, CodingResult

# Bounded coding Agent

The Agents coding package coordinates one host-bounded source/edit/check/repair
objective. It depends on ModelInteraction, native Prompt, existing Agents
model/Tool composition, ToolRunner, RI/Context, scoped source/fixed checks and
managed Resources. Runtime and Conversation retain their narrower contracts.

- `process.run_coding_agent` owns the finite model/proposal phase sequence,
  response-source and native ID checks, continuation and terminal reconciliation.
- `models` owns coding-specific limits and factual candidate/terminal outcomes.
- `repository.RepositoryCodingHost` composes real repository Context acquisition,
  exact current edit admission, fixed validation and feedback. Hosts explicitly
  supply authorization and application/archive/restoration collaborators.
- `projection` selects valid complete native exchanges and affordable exact source
  through existing Context materialization. The neutral host's optional
  `ProjectionPolicy` separates retained original facts from active Prompt/edit
  witnesses; default task and capacity behavior remain unchanged.
- `compaction` optionally obtains bounded, cited working-state notes through a
  separately selected ModelInteraction. A trusted host explicitly requests it
  or enables the conservative omission/value-based adaptive policy,
  and independently selects outbound disclosure and eligible replacement.
  Original history, exact recent/check evidence, source witnesses and custody
  remain authoritative; generated notes never certify effects or acceptance.
- `edits.replace_exact_text` admits one unique bounded literal anchor without
  language/task or repository governance defaults.
  The same owner now composes exact witnessed, nonoverlapping replacements into
  whole admitted after-images through `admit_source_batch`. The repository host
  retains native decoding/count limits, readiness/currentness, feedback, authority
  and effects; its `EditLimits`/`SourceChange` imports remain compatibility facades.
- `custody.SourceCustody` retains canonical known-source correspondence and
  refuses unknown-byte restoration. It is not Checkout, a transaction or store.

Use `CodingLimits` with an explicit interaction and a `CodingHost` composition.
For existing UTF-8 text repairs, supply `CodingObjective`, an authenticated
`SourceScope`, a fixed check plan, a corpus and host callbacks to
`RepositoryCodingHost`. `write_source_changes` is an optional per-file Resource
effect; it grants no scope and does not roll back earlier writes on later failure.

The Qwen compatibility adapter and the independent guarded repository host both
invoke this process; neither implements a second model/repair loop. Unknown
usage stays absent. A dispatch acknowledgment is not external-effect rollback.
Candidate validation remains distinct from worker completion, independent review
and publication. Source observations are not a lock or universal input closure.
Completion effects remain bounded host responsibilities. Transient continuation
and effect notes are not durable task restart or safe replay.

See the [contract, consumers and limitations](../../../../../docs/development/bounded-coding-agent.md).
The [active projection contract](../../../../../docs/development/active-context-projection.md)
documents byte watermarks, complete-schema assembly, protected feedback,
source-witness invalidation, qualified failures and future summary boundaries.
The [semantic compaction contract](../../../../../docs/development/semantic-context-compaction.md)
defines auxiliary budgets, provenance validation, privacy, exact-context
preservation and deterministic fallback. It requires neither a Qwen consumer nor
a live/provider-specific summarizer. Qwen's existing continuation policy remains
separate; the shared coding process and legacy outputs remain unchanged.

The [adaptive policy contract](../../../../../docs/development/adaptive-context-compaction.md)
defines opt-in pressure/value/reserve selection, cached reuse and suppression
after failed auxiliary attempts. Real assessment found no adopted semantic notes;
the policy remains optional and does not claim measured continuation improvement.

The [host-cohesion and edit-size analysis](../../../../../docs/development/coding-host-cohesion.md)
separates pure source admission from lifecycle coordination and explains why
resulting-file, region, disclosure and Prompt byte budgets are independent.

The [source-navigation contract](../../../../../docs/development/source-navigation-continuity.md)
adds opt-in `navigation=True` to the neutral repository host. Native `find_source`
pages/searches existing scoped file/symbol/window metadata; `read_source_unit`
binds a current unit and snapshot to the existing exact source Tool. Metadata
does not grant source or edit credit. Generic range reads and existing projection,
semantic/adaptive compaction and custody remain authoritative. The default
native surface and legacy Qwen application policy remain unchanged.

"""Exact anchored replacement admission; source identity/permission stay explicit."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast

from devtools.context import RepositoryResourceAddress
from devtools.context.repository.resource import ContentIdentity

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping

    from devtools.context.planning.source import SourceRangeDisclosureOption
    from devtools.context.repository.snapshot import RepositorySnapshot


class CodingEditError(ValueError):
    """A proposal was refused before source mutation, with bounded diagnostics."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        details: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Retain independently meaningful refusal facts without changing source."""
        super().__init__(message)
        self.details = details or {}


def replace_exact_text(  # noqa: PLR0913 -- explicit independent host limits/deletion policy
    source: str,
    old_text: object,
    new_text: object,
    *,
    region_bytes: int,
    source_bytes: int,
    allow_empty_new: bool = False,
) -> tuple[str, int, int]:
    """Admit one exact unique anchor using caller limits and original line endings."""
    if not isinstance(old_text, str) or not isinstance(new_text, str):
        raise CodingEditError(
            "Structured edit text values must be strings",
            details={"code": "INVALID_TEXT_TYPE"},
        )
    if (
        not old_text
        or (not new_text and (not allow_empty_new))
        or "\x00" in old_text
        or ("\x00" in new_text)
        or (len(old_text.encode()) > region_bytes)
        or (len(new_text.encode()) > region_bytes)
        or (old_text == new_text)
    ):
        raise CodingEditError(
            "Structured edit text is empty, unchanged or oversized",
            details={
                "code": "EMPTY_TEXT"
                if not old_text or (not new_text and (not allow_empty_new))
                else "NUL_TEXT"
                if "\x00" in old_text or "\x00" in new_text
                else "REGION_BYTE_LIMIT"
                if max(len(old_text.encode()), len(new_text.encode())) > region_bytes
                else "NO_OP",
                "old_bytes": len(old_text.encode()),
                "new_bytes": len(new_text.encode()),
                "region_limit_bytes": region_bytes,
            },
        )
    for text in (source, old_text, new_text):
        without_crlf = text.replace("\r\n", "")
        if (
            "\r" in without_crlf
            or ("\r\n" in text and "\n" in without_crlf)
            or any(
                marker in text
                for marker in (
                    "\x0b",
                    "\x0c",
                    "\x1c",
                    "\x1d",
                    "\x1e",
                    "\x85",
                    "\u2028",
                    "\u2029",
                )
            )
        ):
            raise CodingEditError(
                "Mixed or unsupported structured edit line endings",
                details={"code": "UNSUPPORTED_LINE_ENDINGS"},
            )
    newline = "\r\n" if "\r\n" in source else "\n"
    old_text = old_text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\n", newline)
    new_text = new_text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\n", newline)
    if (
        old_text == new_text
        or max(len(old_text.encode()), len(new_text.encode())) > region_bytes
    ):
        raise CodingEditError(
            "Adapted structured edit is unchanged or oversized",
            details={
                "code": "NO_OP" if old_text == new_text else "REGION_BYTE_LIMIT",
                "adapted_old_bytes": len(old_text.encode()),
                "adapted_new_bytes": len(new_text.encode()),
                "region_limit_bytes": region_bytes,
            },
        )
    matches = 0
    offset = 0
    while (found := source.find(old_text, offset)) >= 0:
        matches += 1
        offset = found + 1
        if matches > 1:
            break
    if matches != 1:
        raise CodingEditError(
            "Old text must match exactly one source region",
            details={"code": "OLD_TEXT_NOT_UNIQUE"},
        )
    updated = source.replace(old_text, new_text, 1)
    if len(updated.encode()) > source_bytes:
        raise CodingEditError(
            "Structured edit exceeds the bounded source size",
            details={
                "code": "SOURCE_BYTE_LIMIT",
                "source_bytes": len(updated.encode()),
                "source_limit_bytes": source_bytes,
            },
        )
    return (updated, source.index(old_text), source.index(old_text) + len(old_text))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class EditLimits:
    """Host-selected region/source/transaction ceilings, without Qwen defaults."""

    region_bytes: int
    source_bytes: int
    aggregate_bytes: int
    operations: int

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        """Refuse unbounded admission before effects."""
        if (
            min(
                self.region_bytes,
                self.source_bytes,
                self.aggregate_bytes,
                self.operations,
            )
            <= 0
        ):
            msg = "Edit limits must be positive."
            raise ValueError(msg)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceChange:
    """Admitted whole after-image with its original addressed source and span."""

    address: RepositoryResourceAddress
    before: str
    after: str
    start: int
    end: int


def admit_source_batch(
    arguments: Iterable[Mapping[str, object]],
    *,
    snapshot: RepositorySnapshot,
    editable: tuple[RepositoryResourceAddress, ...],
    available: tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...],
    limits: EditLimits,
) -> tuple[SourceChange, ...]:
    """Plan exact current, bounded, nonoverlapping replacements without effects.

    The host checks source currentness, readiness and the native operation count
    before entering. Arguments are decoded lazily so a later malformed operation
    cannot hide an earlier admission refusal. No partial plan escapes on error.
    Scope membership and exact disclosed witnesses are checked here; model/Tool
    correlation, authorization, effect entry and custody remain host-owned.
    """
    changes: list[SourceChange] = []
    total = 0
    for values in arguments:
        address = RepositoryResourceAddress(cast("str", values["path"]))
        if address not in editable:
            msg = "Edit path is outside the admitted editing surface."
            raise CodingEditError(msg)
        before = snapshot.resource_at(address).content
        after, start, end = replace_exact_text(
            before,
            values["old_text"],
            values["new_text"],
            region_bytes=limits.region_bytes,
            source_bytes=limits.source_bytes,
            allow_empty_new=True,
        )
        if not any(
            o.unit.resource.address == address
            and o.snapshot_id == snapshot.id
            and o.repository_id == snapshot.repository_id
            and o.unit.resource.content_identity == ContentIdentity.from_text(before)
            and o.span[0] <= start
            and end <= o.span[1]
            for o in available
        ):
            msg = "Exact current edit source was not acquired."
            raise CodingEditError(msg)
        if any(
            c.address == address and start < c.end and c.start < end for c in changes
        ):
            msg = "Edit anchors overlap."
            raise CodingEditError(msg)
        total += len(before[start:end].encode()) + len(
            cast("str", values["new_text"]).encode(),
        )
        if total > limits.aggregate_bytes:
            msg = "Aggregate edit byte limit exceeded."
            raise CodingEditError(msg)
        changes.append(SourceChange(address, before, after, start, end))
    # Combine admitted same-file anchors against the one original version.
    combined = []
    for address in dict.fromkeys(c.address for c in changes):
        original = snapshot.resource_at(address).content
        after = original
        for c in sorted(
            (c for c in changes if c.address == address),
            key=lambda c: c.start,
            reverse=True,
        ):
            inserted = c.after[c.start : len(c.after) - (len(c.before) - c.end)]
            after = after[: c.start] + inserted + after[c.end :]
        if len(after.encode()) > limits.source_bytes:
            msg = "Combined source byte limit exceeded."
            raise CodingEditError(msg)
        combined.append(
            SourceChange(address, original, after, 0, len(original)),
        )
    return tuple(combined)

"""Coding-specific budgets, progress and terminal facts; never a generic Run."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Literal

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from devtools.core.time import Duration
    from devtools.models.interaction import ModelUsage

type CodingDisposition = Literal[
    "validated",
    "stopped",
    "model_limit",
    "proposal_limit",
    "failed",
    "cancelled",
    "reconciliation_required",
]


class CodingLimitError(ValueError):
    """A host-fixed coding budget refuses further dispatch."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CodingLimits:
    """Finite host ceilings, without provider capacity or application defaults."""

    model_calls: int
    proposals: int
    tool_actions: int
    call_timeout: Duration
    wall_timeout: Duration
    completion_check: bool = False

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        """Refuse invalid ceilings before any model or effect entry."""
        if (
            min(self.model_calls, self.proposals) < 1
            or self.tool_actions < 0
            or min(self.call_timeout.total_seconds, self.wall_timeout.total_seconds)
            <= 0
        ):
            msg = (
                "Coding limits require positive calls/proposals/time "
                "and nonnegative actions."
            )
            raise ValueError(msg)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CodingEffect:
    """A dispatch attempt and its acknowledgment, not proof of rollback or entry."""

    kind: Literal["tool", "edit", "check"]
    native_call_ids: tuple[str | None, ...]
    acknowledged: bool = False
    check_name: str | None = None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class CodingProgress:
    """One invocation's coding counters and known facts, shared with its host."""

    limits: CodingLimits
    number: int = 0
    model_calls: int = 0
    proposals: int = 0
    actions: int = 0
    phase: str = "preparation"
    candidate_validated: bool = False
    effects: list[CodingEffect] = field(default_factory=list)
    usage: list[ModelUsage | None] = field(default_factory=list)

    def claim_action(self, call_id: str | None) -> CodingEffect:
        """Charge before dispatch; failure never silently refunds an attempt."""
        if self.actions >= self.limits.tool_actions:
            msg = "Context action budget exhausted"
            raise CodingLimitError(msg)
        self.actions += 1
        effect = CodingEffect("tool", (call_id,))
        self.effects.append(effect)
        return effect


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CodingCompletion:
    """Host custody facts; absence makes no assertion about restoration."""

    restored: bool | None = None
    reconciliation_required: bool = False
    error: BaseException | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CodingResult:
    """Candidate evidence is independent of terminal coding execution success."""

    disposition: CodingDisposition
    candidate_validated: bool
    completed: bool
    progress: CodingProgress
    error: BaseException | None = None
    completion_error: BaseException | None = None
    custody: CodingCompletion = CodingCompletion()
    failure_phase: str | None = None

    @property
    def accepted(self) -> bool:
        """Refuse unconditional success after fatal completion/custody failure."""
        return (
            self.disposition == "validated"
            and self.candidate_validated
            and self.completed
            and not self.custody.reconciliation_required
            and self.custody.restored is not False
        )

"""Native metadata and exact-unit selection over the existing source Tools."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, cast

from devtools.context import RepositoryResourceAddress
from devtools.tools import ToolDescriptor
from devtools.tools.source import SourceNavigationRequest, SourceReadRequest

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Mapping

    from devtools.context.retrieval.source import RepositorySourceUnit
    from devtools.context.retrieval.source.index import SourceSearchIndex
    from devtools.context.retrieval.source.representation import SourceSearchMode

FIND = ToolDescriptor(
    "find_source",
    "Search scoped file/symbol/window metadata. Without query, page the outline. "
    "Prefer small named units; read_source_unit acquires their exact source. "
    "Metadata is not a source witness. offset pages results; path narrows scope.",
    '{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","maxLength":256},'
    '"path":{"type":"string"},"mode":{"enum":["file","symbol","window","mixed"]},'
    '"offset":{"type":"integer","minimum":0}},"additionalProperties":false}',
)
READ_UNIT = ToolDescriptor(
    "read_source_unit",
    "Read an exact current unit from find_source. Partial results report the next "
    "Unicode offset; use read_source for adjacent ranges. Select enclosing/file "
    "IDs from metadata only when needed. Source and request byte limits still apply.",
    '{"type":"object","properties":{"unit_id":{"type":"string"},'
    '"snapshot_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["unit_id","snapshot_id"],'
    '"additionalProperties":false}',
)


def navigation_request(values: Mapping[str, object]) -> SourceNavigationRequest:
    """Materialize only the host-admitted native selection fields."""
    return SourceNavigationRequest(
        cast("str", values.get("query", "")),
        RepositoryResourceAddress(cast("str", values["path"]))
        if "path" in values
        else None,
        cast("SourceSearchMode", values.get("mode", "symbol")),
        cast("int", values.get("offset", 0)),
    )


def unit_read_request(
    index: SourceSearchIndex,
    values: Mapping[str, object],
    *,
    purpose: str,
    maximum_bytes: int,
) -> SourceReadRequest:
    """Bind a model reference to the actual current index; no new source identity."""
    unit = next(
        (u for v in index.views for u in v.units if str(u.id) == values["unit_id"]),
        None,
    )
    if str(index.snapshot.id) != values["snapshot_id"] or unit is None:
        msg = "Source unit is foreign, stale or outside the admitted index."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return SourceReadRequest(purpose, unit, unit.start, unit.end, maximum_bytes)


def navigation_feedback(
    units: tuple[RepositorySourceUnit, ...],
    index: SourceSearchIndex,
    *,
    offset: int,
    maximum_bytes: int,
    page_size: int = 8,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Bound metadata presentation without pretending it disclosed any source."""
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    result: dict[str, object] = {
        "repository_id": str(index.snapshot.repository_id),
        "snapshot_id": str(index.snapshot.id),
        "source_acquired": False,
        "coordinates": "half-open Unicode offsets; one-based physical lines",
        "units": rows,
        "next_offset": None,
        "partial": False,
    }
    for unit in units:
        row: dict[str, object] = {
            "unit_id": str(unit.id),
            "path": str(unit.resource.address),
            "version": str(unit.resource.content_identity),
            "kind": unit.kind,
            "name": unit.qualified_name,
            "span": [unit.start, unit.end],
            "lines": [unit.start_line, unit.end_line],
            "bytes": len(unit.text.encode()),
            "file_id": str(index.expand(unit).id),

class CodingHost[Proposal](Protocol):
    """Coding policy/effect and presentation boundary, exercised by two hosts.

    Implementations use existing Tool composition and claim_action before Tool
    dispatch. They do not own another model/repair loop. Effect admission and
    custody remain host decisions; callbacks must never retry unknown effects.
    """

    native_feedback: bool

    async def prepare(self, progress: CodingProgress) -> ModelRequest:
        """Project bounded current Context and host-selected Tools/settings."""

    async def receive(self, response: ModelResponse) -> None:
        """Retain response facts before semantic source admission."""

    def classify(self, response: ModelResponse) -> Literal["acquire", "edit", "stop"]:
        """Select only host-admitted operation families; never infer authority."""

    async def acquire(self, response: ModelResponse) -> bool:
        """Dispatch bounded Tools and return current completion-check acceptance."""

    async def propose(self, response: ModelResponse) -> Proposal | None:
        """Admit a whole grounded proposal, or retain pre-effect refusal feedback."""

    async def apply(self, proposal: Proposal) -> None:
        """Apply once through host effect owners and verify installed source."""

    async def check(self, proposal: Proposal) -> bool:
        """Run required fixed checks; refuse invalid/unknown source correspondence."""

    async def feedback(
        self,
        response: ModelResponse,
        proposal: Proposal,
        *,
        passed: bool,
    ) -> None:
        """Retain bounded feedback without changing known validation facts."""

    async def finish(self, result: CodingResult) -> CodingCompletion:
        """Reconcile host custody and terminal projection without publication."""


async def run_coding_agent[Proposal](  # noqa: C901, PLR0912, PLR0915 -- one bounded coding phase sequence
    interaction: ModelInteraction,
    *,
    limits: CodingLimits,
    host: CodingHost[Proposal],
) -> CodingResult:
    """Pursue one bounded coding objective with no retry of an ambiguous effect.

    Request/capacity policy, scope/Tool selection, oracles, journals and Checkout
    belong to the supplied host. This owner enforces the coding phase order,
    model/proposal bounds, selected-source validation and terminal reconciliation.
    """
    state = CodingProgress(limits)
    disposition: CodingDisposition = "model_limit"
    error: BaseException | None = None
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(limits.wall_timeout.total_seconds):
            for number in range(1, limits.model_calls + 1):
                state.number, state.phase = number, "preparation"
                request = await host.prepare(state)
                selected_source = interaction.source
                state.phase = "model"
                state.model_calls += 1
                state.usage.append(None)
                async with asyncio.timeout(limits.call_timeout.total_seconds):
                    response = await interaction.send(request)
                state.usage[-1] = response.usage
                state.phase = "response"
                await host.receive(response)
                if response.source != selected_source:
                    msg = (
                        "Model response source does not match model interaction source."
                    )
                    raise ValueError(msg)  # noqa: TRY301 -- preserve the actual failure phase
                kind = host.classify(response)
                if response.termination == ModelTermination.OUTPUT_LIMIT:
                    msg = "Output limit: no repair dispatch"
                    raise ValueError(msg)  # noqa: TRY301 -- preserve the actual failure phase
                if kind == "stop":
                    disposition = "stopped"
                    break
                if host.native_feedback:
                    ids = [c.provider_call_id for c in response.tool_calls]
                    if not ids or not all(ids) or len(set(ids)) != len(ids):
                        msg = "Native calls require distinct nonempty IDs"
                        raise CodingLimitError(msg)  # noqa: TRY301 -- refuse before dispatch
                if kind == "acquire":
                    state.phase = "acquisition"
                    if await host.acquire(response):
                        state.candidate_validated = True
                        disposition = "validated"
                        break
                    continue
                state.phase = "admission"
                if state.proposals >= limits.proposals:
                    msg = "Edit proposal budget exhausted"
                    raise CodingLimitError(msg)  # noqa: TRY301 -- refuse before dispatch
                state.proposals += 1
                proposal = await host.propose(response)
                if proposal is None:
                    if state.proposals >= limits.proposals:
                        disposition = "proposal_limit"
                        break
                    continue
                state.candidate_validated = False
                effect = CodingEffect(
                    "edit",
                    tuple(c.provider_call_id for c in response.tool_calls),
                )
                state.effects.append(effect)
                state.phase = "application"
                await host.apply(proposal)
                effect.acknowledged = True
                state.phase = "validation"
                passed = await host.check(proposal)
                state.candidate_validated = passed
                state.phase = "feedback"
                await host.feedback(response, proposal, passed=passed)
                if passed and not limits.completion_check:
                    disposition = "validated"
                    break
                if not passed and state.proposals >= limits.proposals:
                    disposition = "proposal_limit"
                    break
    except (Exception, asyncio.CancelledError) as failure:  # noqa: BLE001 -- return known facts, never retry provider/effects
        disposition = (
            "cancelled" if isinstance(failure, asyncio.CancelledError) else "failed"
        )
        error = failure
    result = CodingResult(
        disposition,
        state.candidate_validated,
        error is None,
        state,
        error,
    )
    if error is not None:
        result = replace(result, failure_phase=state.phase)
    state.phase = "completion"
    try:
        custody = await host.finish(result)
        if (
            custody.error is not None
            or custody.reconciliation_required
            or custody.restored is False
        ):
            return replace(
                result,
                custody=custody,
                completed=False,
                disposition="reconciliation_required"
                if custody.reconciliation_required
                else "cancelled"
                if isinstance(error or custody.error, asyncio.CancelledError)
                else "failed",
                error=error or custody.error,
                completion_error=custody.error,
                failure_phase=result.failure_phase or "completion",
            )
        return replace(result, custody=custody)
    except (Exception, asyncio.CancelledError) as failure:  # noqa: BLE001 -- primary error remains authoritative
        return replace(
            result,
            completed=False,
            disposition="cancelled"
            if isinstance(error or failure, asyncio.CancelledError)
            else "failed",
            error=error or failure,
            completion_error=failure,
            failure_phase=result.failure_phase or "completion",
        )

def request_bytes(request: ModelRequest) -> int:
    """Count complete host serialization, not provider tokens or HTTP bytes."""
    return len(json.dumps(asdict(request), ensure_ascii=False).encode())


def native_exchange_ranges(
    messages: tuple[PromptMessage, ...],
) -> tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]:
    """Validate Prompt and locate indivisible assistant/result blocks.

    User/system instructions are never included in an evictable range. This
    operation neither selects content nor invokes an operation from history.
    """
    Prompt("", "messages", messages)
    ranges = []
    for index, message in enumerate(messages):
        if message.role == "assistant":
            end = index + 1
            while end < len(messages) and messages[end].role == "tool":
                end += 1
            ranges.append((index, end))
    return tuple(ranges)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProjectionPolicy:
    """Host-selected byte watermarks and known metadata-only operation names.

    Operation names permit presentation omission, never execution. Unknown
    operations and non-Tool assistant text remain protected.
    """

    trigger_bytes: int
    target_bytes: int
    metadata_operations: frozenset[str] = frozenset()

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        """Require explicit bounded watermarks and immutable host classification."""
        if (
            type(self.trigger_bytes) is not int
            or type(self.target_bytes) is not int
            or not 0 < self.target_bytes <= self.trigger_bytes
            or not isinstance(self.metadata_operations, frozenset)
            or any(
                not isinstance(n, str) or not n.strip()
                for n in self.metadata_operations
            )
        ):
            msg = "Invalid active Context projection policy."
            raise ValueError(msg)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

    request: ModelRequest
    status: Literal["unchanged", "reduced", "insufficient"]
    triggered: bool
    original_bytes: int
    resulting_bytes: int
    target_bytes: int
    hard_bytes: int

    omitted_exchanges: tuple[tuple[int, int, str], ...]

    active_sources: tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...]
    invalidated_source_identities: tuple[str, ...]

    @property
    def target_reached(self) -> bool:

class ProjectionCapacityError(ValueError):

    def __init__(self, outcome: ProjectionOutcome) -> None:

def source_feedback(
    option: SourceRangeDisclosureOption,
    text: str,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Project one already materialized exact range into the neutral native format."""
    bounds = source_read_bounds(option)
    # The native descriptor defines coordinates; do not repeat that prose in
    # every disclosure, especially a capacity-limited partial projection.
    del bounds["coordinate_convention"]
    return {
        **bounds,
        "continuation_start": option.start + len(text),
        "remaining_range": [option.start + len(text), option.unit.end],
        "text": text,
        "path": str(option.unit.resource.address),
        "snapshot": str(option.snapshot_id),
        "version": str(option.unit.resource.content_identity),
        "span": option.span,
        "partial": option.truncated,
    }


def _current_sources(
    messages: tuple[PromptMessage, ...],
    sources: Mapping[int, tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...]],
    snapshot: RepositorySnapshot,
) -> dict[int, tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...]]:
    """Authenticate host bindings against actually presented text and Context."""
    current = {}
    for index, options in sources.items():
        value = json.loads(messages[index].content)
        presented = value.get("sources", [value])
        selected = []
        for option in options:
            if (
                option.snapshot_id != snapshot.id
                or option.repository_id != snapshot.repository_id
            ):
                continue
            materialized = materialize_source_range(snapshot, option).items[0]
            expected = {
                "text": materialized.text,
                "path": str(option.unit.resource.address),
                "version": str(option.unit.resource.content_identity),
                "span": list(option.span),
            }
            if not any(
                all(v.get(k) == item for k, item in expected.items())
                and v.get("snapshot", str(snapshot.id)) == str(snapshot.id)
                for v in presented
            ):
                msg = "Source binding does not match presented Context."
                raise ValueError(msg)
            selected.append(option)
        current[index] = tuple(selected)
    return current


def project_request(  # noqa: C901, PLR0912, PLR0913, PLR0915 -- bounded ordered selection, no effect execution
    request: ModelRequest,
    *,
    policy: ProjectionPolicy,
    hard_bytes: int,
    snapshot: RepositorySnapshot,
    sources: Mapping[int, tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...]],
    protected_indices: frozenset[int] = frozenset(),
    summarized_indices: frozenset[int] = frozenset(),
    summary: PromptMessage | None = None,
) -> ProjectionOutcome:
    """Select complete exchanges and affordable exact source without editing history.

    Cheap reductions target the lower watermark. Distinct current source is
    sacrificed only under hard pressure. Newest feedback cannot be dropped;
    a plain source result may instead be explicitly presented as a partial range.
    Protected source/check messages cannot be shortened. Unclassified exchanges
    are retained, including all effectful operations and unknown outcomes.
    """
    if not 0 < policy.target_bytes <= policy.trigger_bytes <= hard_bytes:
        msg = "Projection watermarks exceed the host byte ceiling."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    messages = request.prompt.messages
    ranges = native_exchange_ranges(messages)
    ids = [c.provider_call_id for m in messages for c in m.tool_calls]
    if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
        msg = "Active native history repeats a Tool call ID."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    current = _current_sources(messages, sources, snapshot)
    selected = dict(enumerate(messages))
    original = request_bytes(request)
    omitted: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
    shortened: list[int] = []
    if summarized_indices or summary is not None:
        eligible = {
            i
            for first, end in ranges[:-1]
            if not protected_indices.intersection(range(first, end))
            and set(range(first, end)) <= summarized_indices
            for i in range(first, end)
        }
        if (
            not summarized_indices
            or eligible != summarized_indices
            or summary is None
            or summary.role != "assistant"
            or not summary.content.strip()
            or summary.tool_calls
            or summary.tool_call_id is not None
            or summary.reasoning_content is not None
        ):
            msg = "Semantic projection must replace whole unprotected exchanges."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        for first, end in ranges:
            if first in summarized_indices:
                omitted.append((first, end, "semantic-summary"))
        for i in summarized_indices:
            del selected[i]
    # Only bound plain source results can be shortened or classified as reads.
    plain = {
        i
        for i, options in sources.items()
        if len(options) == 1 and "text" in json.loads(messages[i].content)
    }

    def assembled() -> ModelRequest:
        active = tuple(selected.values())
        if summary is not None:
            active += (summary,)
        return replace(request, prompt=Prompt("", "messages", active))

    def size() -> int:
        return request_bytes(assembled())

    candidates = []
    for first, end in ranges:
        block = messages[first:end]
        if (
            first not in selected
            or (first, end) == ranges[-1]
            or any(i in protected_indices for i in range(first, end))
            or not block[0].tool_calls
            or any(
                i not in plain
                and next(
                    c.name
                    for c in block[0].tool_calls
                    if c.provider_call_id == messages[i].tool_call_id
                )
                not in policy.metadata_operations
                for i in range(first + 1, end)
            )
        ):
            continue
        options = tuple(o for i in range(first, end) for o in current.get(i, ()))
        later = tuple(o for i, values in current.items() if i >= end for o in values)
        if options and all(
            any(
                o.unit.resource == other.unit.resource
                and other.span[0] <= o.span[0] <= o.span[1] <= other.span[1]
                for other in later
            )
            for o in options
        ):
            priority, reason = 0, "duplicate-current-source"
        elif any(i in plain for i in range(first, end)):
            priority, reason = (
                (2, "source-capacity") if options else (0, "stale-source")
            )
        else:
            priority, reason = 1, "host-classified-metadata"
        candidates.append((priority, first, end, reason))
    triggered = original > policy.trigger_bytes
    if triggered:
        for priority, first, end, reason in sorted(candidates):
            if size() <= policy.target_bytes:
                break
            if priority == 2 and size() <= hard_bytes:  # noqa: PLR2004 -- distinct current source tier
                break
            for i in range(first, end):
                del selected[i]
            omitted.append((first, end, reason))
        for index in sorted(plain, reverse=True):
            if size() <= hard_bytes:
                break
            if (
                index not in selected
                or index in protected_indices
                or not current[index]
            ):
                continue
            option = current[index][0]
            if not option.text:
                continue
            original_message = selected[index]

            def partial(
                budget: int,
                *,
                option: SourceRangeDisclosureOption = option,
                original_message: PromptMessage = original_message,
                index: int = index,
            ) -> SourceRangeDisclosureOption:
                smaller = replace(option, maximum_bytes=budget)
                text = materialize_source_range(snapshot, smaller).items[0].text
                value = source_feedback(smaller, text)
                value["presentation"] = {
                    "reason": "active-context-capacity",
                    "original_message_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                        original_message.content.encode(),
                    ).hexdigest(),
                    "acquired_span": option.span,
                    "acquired_partial": option.truncated,
                }
                selected[index] = replace(
                    original_message,
                    content=json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False),
                )
                return smaller

            minimum = len(option.text[0].encode())
            maximum = len(option.text.encode())
            partial(minimum)
            target = (
                policy.target_bytes if size() <= policy.target_bytes else hard_bytes
            )
            if size() > target:
                selected[index] = original_message
                continue
            low, high = minimum, maximum
            while low < high:
                middle = (low + high + 1) // 2
                partial(middle)
                if size() <= target:
                    low = middle
                else:
                    high = middle - 1
            current[index] = (partial(low),)
            shortened.append(index)
    active = tuple(o for i in selected for o in current.get(i, ()))
    active_ids = {o.identity for o in active}
    projected = assembled()
    resulting = request_bytes(projected)
    return ProjectionOutcome(
        projected,
        "insufficient"
        if resulting > hard_bytes
        else "unchanged"
        if projected == request
        else "reduced",
        triggered,
        original,
        resulting,
        policy.target_bytes,
        hard_bytes,
        tuple(selected),
        tuple(omitted),
        tuple(shortened),
        active,
        tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(
                o.identity
                for values in sources.values()
                for o in values
                if o.identity not in active_ids
            ),
        ),
    )

            msg = "Source batch is not the admitted proposal."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.scope.check_current()

    async def execute(self, arguments: tuple[SourceChange, ...]) -> None:
        """Invoke once; any exception can follow a completed external effect."""
        await self.effect(arguments)


def _arguments(
    serialized: str,
    fields: set[str],
    *,
    optional: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Validate this host's small native argument object, not arbitrary JSON Schema."""

    def pairs(items: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
        value = dict(items)
        if len(value) != len(items):
            msg = "Duplicate coding argument member."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return value

    value = json.loads(serialized, object_pairs_hook=pairs)
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or not fields <= set(value) <= fields | optional:
        msg = "Coding arguments do not match the admitted operation."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    return value


class RepositoryCodingHost:
    """Operational source/edit/check host for the shared bounded coding process.

    Native continuation is transient, not a restart checkpoint. Required host
    callbacks supply effect authority, application/archive and restoration;
    readiness may reuse existing Localization without mandating one frame form.
    """

    native_feedback = True

    def __init__(  # noqa: PLR0913 -- explicit scope, effects and custody collaborators
        self,
        objective: CodingObjective,
        *,
        corpus: RepositoryTextCorpusDefinition,
        authorize: Callable[[ModelToolCall, object], Awaitable[None]],
        apply_changes: Callable[[tuple[SourceChange, ...]], Awaitable[None]],
        archive: Callable[[Mapping[RepositoryResourceAddress, str | None]], None],
        restore: Callable[[RepositoryResourceAddress, str | None], None],
        readiness: Callable[
            [RepositorySnapshot, tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...]],
            None,
        ]
        | None = None,
        settings: ModelSettings = _SETTINGS,
        projection: ProjectionPolicy | None = None,
        summary: SummaryCompaction | None = None,
        navigation: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Bind host authority and the existing Context/Tool/Resource substrates."""
        if corpus.discovery.repository_id != objective.scope.snapshot.repository_id:
            msg = "Coding corpus belongs to a foreign repository."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.objective, self.scope, self.corpus = objective, objective.scope, corpus
        if projection is not None and projection.trigger_bytes > objective.prompt_bytes:
            msg = "Projection watermarks exceed the host byte ceiling."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.projection = projection
        self.navigation = navigation
        if summary is not None and projection is None:
            msg = "Semantic compaction requires active Context projection."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.compaction = SemanticCompactor(summary) if summary is not None else None
        self.authorize, self.effect = authorize, apply_changes
        self.archive, self.restore, self.readiness, self.settings = (
            archive,
            restore,
            readiness,
            settings,
        )
        self.custody = SourceCustody(
            self.scope.root,
            {
                r.address: r.content
                for r in self.scope.snapshot.resources
                if r.address in objective.editable
            },
            maximum_bytes=self.scope.maximum_resource_bytes,
        )
        self.messages = [PromptMessage("user", objective.text)]
        self.disclosures: list[SourceRangeDisclosureOption] = []
        self.source_results: list[ContextDisclosure] = []
        self.active_disclosures: tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...] = ()
        self.projection_outcomes: list[ProjectionOutcome] = []
        self.projection_error: BaseException | None = None
        self._source_messages: dict[int, tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...]] = {}
        self._check_feedback: set[int] = set()
        self.requests: list[ModelRequest] = []
        self.responses: list[ModelResponse] = []
        self.check_results: list[tuple[FixedCheckResult, ...]] = []
        self.last_completion = CodingCompletion()
        self._index()

    def _index(self) -> None:
        self.index = build_source_search_index(
            self.scope.snapshot,
            corpus=realize_repository_text_corpus(
                definition=self.corpus,
                snapshot=self.scope.snapshot,
            ),
        )

    def build_request(self, messages: tuple[PromptMessage, ...]) -> ModelRequest:
        """Assemble all host-selected schemas before complete-input accounting.

        Hosts exposing additional operations override this pure assembly seam,
        not append schemas after preparation has checked its byte ceiling.
        """
        return ModelRequest(
            Prompt("", "messages", messages),
            settings=self.settings,
            tools=tuple(
                normalize_tool_descriptor(d)
                for d in (
                    _READ,
                    _EDIT,
                    _CHECK,
                    *((FIND, READ_UNIT) if self.navigation else ()),
                )
            ),
        )

    async def prepare(self, progress: CodingProgress) -> ModelRequest:  # noqa: C901 -- atomic projection and currentness guards
        """Authenticate source and atomically install a valid active projection."""
        self.progress = progress
        self.scope.check_current()
        request = self.build_request(tuple(self.messages))
        if self.projection is not None:
            policy = self.projection
            try:
                if any(not e.acknowledged for e in progress.effects):
                    msg = "Unacknowledged effects require reconciliation."
                    raise ValueError(msg)  # noqa: TRY301 -- retain original preparation failure
                protected = frozenset(self._check_feedback) | (
                    frozenset(
                        i
                        for i, values in self._source_messages.items()
                        if any(o.snapshot_id == self.scope.snapshot.id for o in values)
                    )
                    if self.readiness is not None
                    else frozenset()
                )
                if self.compaction is not None:
                    protected |= self.compaction.protect(request.prompt.messages)
                outcome = project_request(
                    request,
                    policy=self.projection,
                    hard_bytes=self.objective.prompt_bytes,
                    snapshot=self.scope.snapshot,
                    sources=self._source_messages,
                    protected_indices=protected,
                )
                self.projection_outcomes.append(outcome)
                if self.compaction is not None:

                    def summarized(
                        indices: frozenset[int],
                        note: PromptMessage,
                    ) -> ProjectionOutcome:
                        self.scope.check_current()
                        if tuple(self.messages) != request.prompt.messages:
                            msg = "Original history changed during semantic compaction."
                            raise ValueError(msg)  # noqa: TRY301 -- no stale projection
                        return project_request(
                            request,
                            policy=policy,
                            hard_bytes=self.objective.prompt_bytes,
                            snapshot=self.scope.snapshot,
                            sources=self._source_messages,
                            protected_indices=protected,
                            summarized_indices=indices,
                            summary=note,
                        )

                    selected = await self.compaction.project(
                        request,
                        outcome,
                        protected=protected,
                        sources=self._source_messages,
                        snapshot=str(self.scope.snapshot.id),
                        project=summarized,
                    )
                    # Also recheck after optional failure: a fallback is not safe
                    # if an external actor changed source during the await.
                    self.scope.check_current()
                    if tuple(self.messages) != request.prompt.messages:
                        msg = "Original history changed during semantic compaction."
                        raise ValueError(msg)  # noqa: TRY301 -- no stale fallback installation
                    if selected is not outcome:
                        self.projection_outcomes.append(selected)
                    outcome = selected
                if outcome.status == "insufficient":
                    raise ProjectionCapacityError(outcome)  # noqa: TRY301 -- no partial active-state installation
            except (Exception, asyncio.CancelledError) as error:
                self.projection_error = error
                raise
            request = outcome.request
            self.active_disclosures = outcome.active_sources
            self.projection_error = None
        elif request_bytes(request) > self.objective.prompt_bytes:
            msg = "Coding Prompt byte budget exceeded."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.requests.append(request)
        return request

    def request_compaction(self) -> None:
        """Request one host-authorized auxiliary strategy at the next preparation.

        This is not a model Tool, a budget reset, or permission to disclose all
        history. The configured selector and finite envelope remain authoritative.
        """
        if self.compaction is None:
            msg = "No semantic compaction interaction is authorized."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.compaction.pending = True

    async def receive(self, response: ModelResponse) -> None:
        """Retain normalized response facts; the shared process authenticates source."""
        self.responses.append(response)

    def classify(self, response: ModelResponse) -> Literal["acquire", "edit", "stop"]:
        """Refuse mixed/unavailable operations before any partial batch executes."""
        self.scope.check_current()
        self.messages.append(
            PromptMessage(
                "assistant",
                response.content,
                response.tool_calls,
                reasoning_content=response.reasoning_content
                if self.settings.thinking_enabled
                else None,
            ),
        )
        if not response.tool_calls:
            return "stop"
        if all(
            c.name in {_READ.name, _CHECK.name}
            or (self.navigation and c.name in {FIND.name, READ_UNIT.name})
            for c in response.tool_calls
        ):
            return "acquire"
        if all(c.name == _EDIT.name for c in response.tool_calls):
            return "edit"
        msg = "Coding response contains an unadmitted or mixed operation."
        raise ValueError(msg)

    def _read(self, serialized: str) -> SourceReadRequest:
        values = _arguments(serialized, {"path", "start"}, optional=frozenset({"end"}))
        unit = next(
            (
                u
                for u in self.index.views[0].units
                if u.resource.address.value == values["path"]
            ),
            None,
        )
        if unit is None:
            msg = "Source path is outside the admitted corpus."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        return SourceReadRequest(
            self.objective.text,
            unit,
            cast("int", values["start"]),
            cast("int | None", values.get("end", unit.end)),
            self.objective.disclosure_bytes,
        )

    def _read_unit(self, serialized: str) -> SourceReadRequest:
        return unit_read_request(
            self.index,
            _arguments(serialized, {"unit_id", "snapshot_id"}),
            purpose=self.objective.text,
            maximum_bytes=self.objective.disclosure_bytes,
        )

    def _feedback(
        self,
        call: ModelToolCall,
        value: object,
        *,
        sources: tuple[SourceRangeDisclosureOption, ...] = (),
    ) -> None:
        if sources:
            self._source_messages[len(self.messages)] = sources
        self.messages.append(
            PromptMessage(
                "tool",
                json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False),
                tool_call_id=call.provider_call_id,
            ),
        )

    async def acquire(self, response: ModelResponse) -> bool:
        """Use shared composition and retain each bounded Tool result."""
        ready = False
        if (
            len(response.tool_calls)
            > self.progress.limits.tool_actions - self.progress.actions
        ):
            for call in response.tool_calls:
                self._feedback(call, {"status": "REFUSED", "reason": "action_budget"})
            return False
        for call in response.tool_calls:
            effect = self.progress.claim_action(call.provider_call_id)
            if self.navigation and call.name == FIND.name:
                selection = navigation_request(
                    _arguments(
                        call.arguments_json,
                        set(),
                        optional=frozenset({"path", "query", "mode", "offset"}),
                    ),
                )

                def selected_navigation(
                    _: str,
                    selected: SourceNavigationRequest = selection,
                ) -> SourceNavigationRequest:
                    return selected

                units = await execute_model_tool_call(
                    call,
                    invocation=_Invocation(FIND, selected_navigation),
                    tool=ScopedSourceNavigationTool(self.scope, self.index),
                    admit=self.authorize,
                    runner=ToolRunner(),
                )
                self._feedback(
                    call,
                    navigation_feedback(
                        units,
                        self.index,
                        offset=selection.offset,
                        maximum_bytes=self.objective.disclosure_bytes,
                    ),
                )
            elif call.name in {_READ.name, READ_UNIT.name}:
                tool: Tool[SourceReadRequest, ContextDisclosure | SourceReadRefusal] = (
                    ScopedSourceTool(
                        self.scope,
                        maximum_bytes=self.objective.disclosure_bytes,
                    )
                )
                disclosure = await execute_model_tool_call(
                    call,
                    invocation=_Invocation[SourceReadRequest](
                        READ_UNIT if call.name == READ_UNIT.name else _READ,
                        self._read_unit if call.name == READ_UNIT.name else self._read,
                    ),
                    tool=tool,
                    admit=self.authorize,
                    runner=ToolRunner(),
                )
                if isinstance(disclosure, SourceReadRefusal):
                    self._feedback(
                        call,
                        {
                            "status": "REFUSED",
                            "error": "SOURCE_RANGE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS",
                            "source_disclosure_entered": False,
                            "path": str(disclosure.request.unit.resource.address),
                            "snapshot": str(disclosure.request.unit.snapshot_id),
                            "version": str(
                                disclosure.request.unit.resource.content_identity,
                            ),
                            **source_read_bounds(disclosure.request),
                            "instruction": (
                                "Select a new valid interval; "
                                "this call disclosed no source."
                            ),
                        },
                    )
                    effect.acknowledged = True
                    continue
                option = cast(
                    "SourceRangeDisclosureOption",
                    disclosure.items[0].native_provenance,
                )
                self.source_results.append(disclosure)
                self.disclosures.append(option)
                self._feedback(
                    call,
                    source_feedback(option, disclosure.items[0].text),
                    sources=(option,),
                )
            else:
                _arguments(call.arguments_json, set())
                await self.authorize(call, self.objective.checks)
                passed = await self.check(())
                self.progress.candidate_validated = passed
                ready = passed and self.progress.proposals > 0
                self._check_feedback = {len(self.messages)}
                self._feedback(call, {"passed": passed})
            effect.acknowledged = True
        return ready

    async def propose(self, response: ModelResponse) -> tuple[SourceChange, ...] | None:
        """Admit all exact, observed, current, nonoverlapping source anchors first."""
        self.pending_calls = response.tool_calls
        try:
            self.scope.check_current()
            available = (
                self.active_disclosures
                if self.projection is not None
                else tuple(self.disclosures)
            )
            if self.readiness is not None:
                self.readiness(self.scope.snapshot, available)
            if len(response.tool_calls) > self.objective.edits.operations:
                msg = "Edit operation limit exceeded."
                raise CodingEditError(msg)
            return admit_source_batch(
                (
                    _arguments(call.arguments_json, {"path", "old_text", "new_text"})
                    for call in response.tool_calls
                ),
                snapshot=self.scope.snapshot,
                editable=self.objective.editable,
                available=available,
                limits=self.objective.edits,
            )
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
            for call in response.tool_calls:
                self._feedback(call, {"status": "REFUSED", "reason": str(error)})
            return None

    async def apply(self, proposal: tuple[SourceChange, ...]) -> None:
        """Record expected source before effects and verify installed bytes."""
        call = self.pending_calls[0]

        async def admit(
            selected_call: ModelToolCall,
            changes: tuple[SourceChange, ...],
        ) -> None:
            await self.authorize(selected_call, changes)
            for change in changes:
                self.custody.expect(change.address, change.after)

        def selected(serialized: str) -> tuple[SourceChange, ...]:
            if serialized != call.arguments_json:
                msg = "Edit call differs from admitted arguments."
                raise ValueError(msg)
            return proposal

        await execute_model_tool_call(
            call,
            invocation=_Invocation(_EDIT, selected),
            tool=_ChangeTool(self.scope, proposal, self.effect),
            admit=admit,
            runner=ToolRunner(),
        )
        observed = SourceScope.observe(
            root=self.scope.root,
            repository=Repository(self.scope.snapshot.repository_id),
            addresses=tuple(r.address for r in self.scope.snapshot.resources),
            maximum_resource_bytes=self.scope.maximum_resource_bytes,
        )
        expected = {r.address: r.content for r in self.scope.snapshot.resources}
        expected.update({c.address: c.after for c in proposal})
        if {r.address: r.content for r in observed.snapshot.resources} != expected:
            msg = "Installed source differs from the admitted candidate."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        self.scope = observed
        self.active_disclosures = ()
        self._index()
        self.disclosures = []
        for change in proposal:
            unit = next(
                u
                for u in self.index.views[0].units
                if u.resource.address == change.address
            )
            option = SourceRangeDisclosureOption(
                self.objective.text,
                unit,
                0,
                unit.end,
                self.objective.disclosure_bytes,
            )
            # The exact after-image is already known; materialize it through Context.
            disclosure = await ToolRunner().execute(
                ScopedSourceTool(
                    self.scope,
                    maximum_bytes=self.objective.disclosure_bytes,
                ),
                option,
            )
            self.source_results.append(disclosure)
            self.disclosures.append(option)

    async def check(self, proposal: tuple[SourceChange, ...]) -> bool:
        """Execute the unchanged host plan and preserve each known result in order."""
        del proposal
        tool = FixedCheckTool(replace(self.objective.checks, source_scope=self.scope))
        results: list[FixedCheckResult] = []
        self.check_results.append(())
        for check in tool.plan.checks:
            effect = CodingEffect("check", (), check_name=check.name)
            self.progress.effects.append(effect)
            result = await ToolRunner().execute(tool, check.name)
            effect.acknowledged = True
            results.append(result)
            self.check_results[-1] = tuple(results)
        return all(r.passed for r in results)

    async def feedback(
        self,
        response: ModelResponse,
        proposal: tuple[SourceChange, ...],
        *,
        passed: bool,
    ) -> None:
        """Return bounded actual diagnostics under native call IDs."""
        del proposal
        value = {
            "passed": passed,
            "checks": [
                {
                    "name": r.check.name,
                    "exit_code": r.command_result.exit_code,
                    "stdout": r.command_result.stdout.decode(errors="replace"),
                    "stderr": r.command_result.stderr.decode(errors="replace"),
                    "current": r.inputs_current,
                }
                for r in self.check_results[-1]
            ],
            "sources": [
                {
                    "path": str(o.unit.resource.address),
                    "text": o.text,
                    "span": o.span,
                    "version": str(o.unit.resource.content_identity),
                }
                for o in self.disclosures
            ],
        }
        self._check_feedback = set()
        for call in response.tool_calls:
            self._check_feedback.add(len(self.messages))
            self._feedback(call, value, sources=tuple(self.disclosures))

    async def finish(self, result: CodingResult) -> CodingCompletion:
        """Archive and restore known source, retaining secondary failures."""
        del result
        current = self.custody.capture()
        error: BaseException | None = None
        try:
            self.archive(current)
        except (Exception, asyncio.CancelledError) as failure:  # noqa: BLE001 -- retain known candidate and still attempt authorized cleanup
            error = failure
        try:
            self.last_completion = self.custody.restore_known(current, self.restore)
        except (Exception, asyncio.CancelledError) as failure:  # noqa: BLE001 -- no retry or false restoration fact
            error = error or failure
        return replace(self.last_completion, error=error)

def normalize_tool_descriptor(descriptor: ToolDescriptor) -> ModelToolDefinition:
    """Project an explicit Tool disclosure into model-facing semantics only."""
    try:
        schema = json.loads(descriptor.input_schema_json)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:  # Defensive after descriptor validation.
        msg = "Tool descriptor input schema must be valid JSON."
        raise ValueError(msg) from error
    if not isinstance(schema, dict):  # Defensive after descriptor validation.
        msg = "Tool descriptor input schema must be a JSON object."
        raise TypeError(msg)
    return ModelToolDefinition(
        name=descriptor.name,
        description=descriptor.description,
        input_schema_json=json.dumps(schema, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")),
    )


async def execute_model_tool_call[ArgumentsT, ResultT](
    call: ModelToolCall,
    *,
    invocation: ToolInvocation[ArgumentsT],
    tool: Tool[ArgumentsT, ResultT],
    admit: Callable[[ModelToolCall, ArgumentsT], Awaitable[None]],
    runner: ToolRunner,
) -> ResultT:
    """Materialize, host-admit and delegate one selected call exactly once.

    Bind the native operation to its selected invocation descriptor, not to the
    possibly multiplexing Tool's name. The materializer must be effect-free.
    Admission must raise to refuse; it is required and runs before ToolRunner's
    semantic validation and execution. The Tool-defined result is returned as-is
    for host correlation with ``call``. Nothing retries, catches cancellation,
    invents feedback or infers rollback from an exception. A failed invocation
    may already have effects; a repeated call is a new host decision.
    """
    if call.name != invocation.descriptor.name:
        msg = "Model Tool call does not match the host-selected invocation."
        raise ValueError(msg)
    arguments = invocation.materialize(call.arguments_json)
    await admit(call, arguments)
    return await runner.execute(tool, arguments)

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FixedCheck:
    """One named host-owned argv, cwd, timeout and success policy."""

    name: str
    command: Command


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FixedCheckPlan:
    """A bounded ordered selection; no model input can change its Commands.

    Optional source scope attests only those declared text resources, not a
    universal dependency/toolchain closure. With no scope, command exit/output
    is the entire claim; the host must supply any stronger admission contract.
    """

    root: ResolvedPath
    checks: tuple[FixedCheck, ...]
    source_scope: SourceScope | None = None
    output_policy: CommandOutputPolicy = _OUTPUT_POLICY

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        """Refuse mutable, ambiguous, unbounded or foreign working plans."""
        if (
            not isinstance(self.checks, tuple)
            or not self.checks
            or len({check.name for check in self.checks}) != len(self.checks)
            or any(not check.name.strip() for check in self.checks)
            or (self.source_scope is not None and self.source_scope.root != self.root)
        ):
            msg = "Fixed check plan requires distinct names and matching host scope."
            raise ValueError(msg)
        for check in self.checks:
            command = check.command
            if (
                command.working_directory is None
                or not command.working_directory.value.is_relative_to(self.root.value)
                or command.timeout is None
                or command.timeout.total_seconds <= 0
            ):
                msg = "Fixed checks require scoped working directories and timeouts."
                raise ValueError(msg)

    def select(self, name: str) -> FixedCheck:
        """Resolve only a host-fixed name, never model-supplied executable input."""
        for check in self.checks:
            if check.name == name:
                return check
        msg = "Check is not in the host-admitted plan."
        raise ToolInputError(msg)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

    """Retain known execution even if post-execution source checking fails."""

    check: FixedCheck
    command_result: CommandResult
    inputs_current: bool | None
    input_error: Exception | None = None

    @property
    def passed(self) -> bool:
        """Report only this declared check, never candidate/protected acceptance."""
        return (
            self.command_result.succeeded
            and not self.command_result.stdout_truncated
            and not self.command_result.stderr_truncated
            and self.inputs_current is not False
        )


class FixedCheckTool:

    name = "run_fixed_check"
    description = "Execute one immutable host-selected bounded check."

    def __init__(self, plan: FixedCheckPlan) -> None:
        """Bind the immutable plan and canonical executor output policy."""
        self.plan = plan

            resolve_path(self.plan.root.value) != self.plan.root
            or cwd is None

            raise ToolInputError(msg)

            self.plan.source_scope.check_current()

    async def execute(self, arguments: str) -> FixedCheckResult:
        """Delegate once and preserve known results or the original exception."""
